correctness.rationale: PASS: For every compatible metric on the compact bilateral product, uniform coordinate boxes sandwich two-sided Bowen balls with uniform radii. Independence and attained maxima give sup_x μ(C_r(x))=∏_j q_j(r). Finite radius-r covering gives uniform q_j≥1/N_r, so the product vanishes iff ∑_j(1−q_j(r)) diverges. Portmanteau with moving closed intervals proves q upper semicontinuous in ν; the fixed-r=1/4 divergence locus is a dense G_delta. The summably contaminated, shrinking-interval tail has strictly positive box mass at every radius and every marginal has full support and no atoms. No stationarity assumption or finite-to-infinite extrapolation.
